Analysis of the logs: An AttackMate framework (an automated attack emulation tool, identified by the "/usr/local/share/attackmate" path) drives a headless Chromium browser on adminpc1 to log into a ZoneMinder web interface at 172.17.100.121 using the admin account. Around the login, the host performs DNS lookups for RustDesk relay domains (a remote-access tool) and an external IP lookup via ipinfo.io. On the video server, a successful admin login is followed by a root-level `find ... -delete` command against PHP session files (`/var/lib/php/sessions/sess_*`), a session-cleanup/anti-forensics style action run outside normal maintenance context. The combination of automated browser-driven credential use, remote-access tool preparation, external IP reconnaissance, and cleanup of session artifacts strongly indicates adversary activity.
